mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the UNRATE increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased consistently over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it indicates strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS growth outpaced GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over a month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 3%, it indicates strong economic growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 YoY growth exceeded 3%.
